categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Carries the P2P label and modifies connection management and message timeout handling in src/net_processing.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents spurious peer disconnections during block download on slow connections where block responses delay pong messages past the 20-minute timeout. As noted in the description, peers prioritizing block responses over pings can trigger ping timeouts and drop well-behaved nodes.
